references.text: Here are mentioned the sons of Asher: Jimna, Jishva, Jishvi and Beria, as well as their sister Serah. This is the original genealogy to which Numbers 26:44 refers in the census.
The first census of the tribe of Asher at Sinai, counting 41,500 men. This forms the basis for comparison with the second census in chapter 26.
Asher is mentioned among Jacob's sons who came to Egypt, confirming the tribe's origin before their stay in Egypt.
The genealogical record of Asher's descendants in Chronicles, which includes Jimna, Jishva, Jishvi and Beria, and provides further details about their family lines.
The description of the tribal inheritance of Asher in Canaan, showing how the families from the census received their territory.
